note: The canonical case: Spanish, relative date, count stated in digits.
text: hola, necesito precio para lavado de 3 camionetas mañana temprano

note: Weekday resolved forward from a Saturday reference.
text: Hi, my name is David Cole. Need a full detail on my SUV this Friday, phone 6123-4455

note: Urgency stated without any date — the date must stay null, not be guessed.
text: URGENTE necesito que me revisen el carro, hace un ruido raro. me llamo Carlos

note: Subscription must win over the word 'wash' that appears in the same sentence.
text: What does the monthly plan cost? I'd wash the car maybe twice a week.

note: Email present in the body; 'hoy' pins both the date and the urgency.
text: Buenas, quiero lavado hoy si se puede. escribanme a ana.mendez@correo.com

note: Count written as a word, not a digit.
text: Somos una empresa, necesitamos lavado para cinco vehiculos el lunes

note: Damage vocabulary maps to repair, not to wash.
text: somebody left a dent on my pickup in the parking lot. can you fix it?

note: An explicit ISO date must beat any relative wording.
text: quiero agendar un pulido para el 2026-05-05, gracias

note: Digit count with the English noun.
text: Quote for washing 2 cars tomorrow please

note: 'pasado mañana' must not collapse into 'mañana'.
text: pasado mañana puedo llevar la moto para limpieza

note: A vague enquiry: service is genuinely unknown and must read 'other'.
text: Hey, are you guys open on Sundays?

note: Dropped letter and a missing tilde — the stem match still classifies it.
text: necesito lavdo para mi camioneta manana

note: International dialling format.
text: This is Marcus. Detailing for a van, call me on +507 6123 9988

note: Two vehicle types in one enquiry.
text: tengo un sedan y una camioneta, cuanto por lavar los dos?

note: 'right now' is asap, and it also fixes the date to today.
text: Can someone look at my car right now? Engine light is on.

note: Encerado is detailing.
text: buenas, hacen encerado? mi auto lo necesita

note: Check-up maps to inspection.
text: Booking a check-up for the truck before a long trip

note: Larger fleet, word form.
text: cotizacion para siete carros de la flota, lavado mensual no, solo una vez

note: A message cut off mid-sentence still has to produce a valid record.
text: hi i need my suv washed on tuesd

note: Rayón is repair; the accent is optional in real messages.
text: tengo un rayon en la puerta del carro, lo pueden arreglar el viernes?
